LESSON: CONSTITUTION OF MADINA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.5: Constitution of Madina

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Constitution of Madina. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Constitution of Madina
2. Practise Constitution of Madina at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constitution of Madina

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Constitution of Madina
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Constitution of Madina. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Constitution of Madina at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Constitution of Madina at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constitution of Madina
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Constitution of Madina. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Constitution of Madina using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Constitution of Madina in the examples.
2. Explain Constitution of Madina to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Constitution of Madina.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Constitution of Madina using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Constitution of Madina important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Constitution of Madina
2. Practise Constitution of Madina at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constitution of Madina

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
